verdicts.claim: Every child born beats both parents on GATE, re-run by birthCheck on the ground.
verdicts.saw: 66 of 66 children beat both parents on GATE when re-run

verdicts.claim: Every child names both parents in its seal, is sealed by its breeder, carries the higher of their bars, and is issued at generation one.
verdicts.saw: 66 of 66 carry both parents, their breeder, the higher bar and generation one

verdicts.claim: Every pair that bore no child says why with the numbers: the best child seen against the parent it had to beat, and how many crossings were tried.
verdicts.saw: 59 pairs bore none, each saying why with its numbers

verdicts.claim: Within a department, at least 50% of children born score above both parents on TEST.
verdicts.saw: 12 of 26 same-department children above both parents on TEST

verdicts.claim: Across departments, at least 80% of children born score above both parents on TEST.
verdicts.saw: 40 of 40 cross-department children above both parents on TEST

verdicts.claim: At least 30% of same-department pairs bear a child within 12 crossings.
verdicts.saw: 26 of 75 same-department pairs bore a child
